location: src/haute/_json_shred.py:1199-1221 (infer_v2_schema_from_data column assembly; the object-table branch `f"{table_path}.{col_name}"` at :1213) interacting with the reserved sentinel `_SCALAR_VALUE_LEAF` (:72) consumed in shred_to_buffers._walk at :629-632
title: A literal JSON key named "$value" collides with the reserved scalar-array sentinel, so inference emits a $value-leaf column on an OBJECT table and shred_to_buffers silently drops EVERY record of that table
description: The module reserves the leaf token `$value` (`_SCALAR_VALUE_LEAF`) to mean "the scalar element itself" for scalar-array child tables, and the header comment (lines 70-71) asserts "a JSON key can't be `$value` in this path grammar, so there's no collision with a real field." That assertion is false. `infer_v2_schema_from_data` builds an object column's path as `f"{table_path}.{col_name}"` with NO escaping/guarding of `col_name`, so a record carrying a real key `"$value"` yields an object-table column with path `$[*].$value`. At shred time `parse_column_path` returns the leaf `$value`, which EQUALS `_SCALAR_VALUE_LEAF`. In `shred_to_buffers._walk`, `is_scalar_table = any(leaf == _SCALAR_VALUE_LEAF ...)` (line 629) then becomes TRUE for what is actually an OBJECT table, so the shape guard `if is_scalar_table != (not is_dict)` (line 630) treats every dict record as a shape mismatch and `continue`s past it (counting it as a skipped row). The whole table emits ZERO rows. Because validate_v2_schema accepts `$value` as a legal leaf and `_v2_fingerprint` sees a distinct path, the cache is judged valid/fresh; the only signal is the skipped-rows counter (which the user must notice). This is distinct from the catalogued 'scalar-value-column-fixed-name-ambiguity' finding (that is about output-port identity / a real field named `value` being indistinguishable downstream); here the *sentinel* `$value` causes total, silent row loss on the build path.
evidence: Reproduced end-to-end: records=[{"$value":10,"other":1},{"$value":20,"other":2}] -> infer_v2_schema_from_data emits root column path '$[*].$value'; parse_column_path('$[*].$value','$[*]') == '$value' == _SCALAR_VALUE_LEAF (True). build_per_port_cache + load_per_port_cache -> root frame height=0 (columns ['$value','other']) from 2 source records; shred_to_buffers skip stats = {'records':0,'rows_by_table':{'$[*]':2}}. Trace: _walk line 629 is_scalar_table=True for a dict record (is_dict=True), line 630 True != (not True=False) -> True -> _count_row_skip + continue, so no row is ever appended.
